purpose: Corrected W1L1 scheduler membership evidence using the Protected Mode entry layout: two independent near callback words followed by the pooled-object offset.

static_export.independent_project_check: passed; project-a and project-b outputs matched

entry_layout.name: phase_callback_offset
entry_layout.use: 0E96 reads this word, compares it with FFFF, and calls it with near CALL AX after phase filtering

entry_layout.name: secondary_callback_offset
entry_layout.use: 0FA2 reads this word, skips zero, and calls it with near CALL AX; 0FDC tests it for presence

entry_layout.name: object_offset
entry_layout.use: all three scheduler passes load this word into DI

entry_layout.name: entry_word_06
entry_layout.use: not read by 0E96, 0FA2, or 0FDC; retained address-named

observations.interpretation: The entry's phase callback is the player update; its separate secondary callback word is the common 1997 presentation path.
Bank rotation changes the physical append index; phase callback offset plus object offset remain the stable observed player identity.

closed: 01F7:0FA2 uses the bank selected by DS:7966 bit 0x0200.
The scheduler entry is not a callback offset/segment far pointer.
The phase callback at +0x00 is 01F7:3FF8 for the observed player entry.
The secondary callback at +0x02 is 01F7:1997 for the observed player entry.
The pooled player object offset is zero in both observed rotated-bank entries.
still_open: membership rebuild timing after player death, reload, jump detachment, or platform culling
whether every main-loop callsite uses the same bank contents outside this W1L1 startup window
the meaning of entry +0x06, which the scheduler passes do not read
